section: Linguistic reorganisation demand; Potti Sriramulu's fast and the formation of Andhra State 1953
subsections: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events of the Andhra State movement in chronological order:
A. Formation of the Visalandhra Mahasabha
B. Swami Sitaram's fast
C. Setting up of the States Reorganisation Commission
D. Setting up of the Dhar Commission
accepted.x: The Dhar Commission was set up in 1948, followed by the Visalandhra Mahasabha in 1949, Swami Sitaram's fast in 1951 and the States Reorganisation Commission in December 1953.
accepted.tq: Use the first-and-last events to eliminate sequences before checking the middle events.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: The Andhra Mahasabha held at Bapatla in 1913 is significant in the history of Andhra because it marked the:
o: Signing of the Sri Bagh Pact
First formal organisation of the Andhra movement
Launch of the separate Telangana movement
accepted.x: The Andhra Mahasabha at Bapatla in 1913 was an early organised expression of the demand for a separate Andhra province.
accepted.tq: Identify the earliest organisational milestone rather than a later constitutional development.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Dhar Commission functioned during 1948. The JVP Committee belonged to 1948–49, the Visalandhra Mahasabha was formed in 1949 and the States Reorganisation Commission was appointed in December 1953.
accepted.tq: Match each institution with its year, rejecting the options with shifted dates.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Dhar Commission was followed by the JVP Committee.
2. The Madras Partition Committee functioned during 1949–50.
3. The Wanchoo inquiry was conducted during February–March 1953.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The sequence included the Dhar Commission and JVP Committee, the Madras Partition Committee in 1949–50 and the Wanchoo inquiry in early 1953.
accepted.tq: Check the dates of successive commissions and inquiries rather than relying only on their names.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the period of the JVP Committee in relation to the Andhra State movement?
accepted.x: The JVP Committee functioned from December 1948 to April 1949. The other periods refer respectively to the Dhar Commission, the Madras Partition Committee and the Wanchoo inquiry.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely placed date ranges belonging to related bodies.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: The Visalandhra Mahasabha, formed in 1949, was intended to represent the demand for a state comprising:
o: The Telugu and Tamil-speaking areas jointly
accepted.x: The Visalandhra Mahasabha was formed to advocate the integration of all Telugu-speaking areas.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the geographical scope of an organisation from the narrower regional demands.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Andhra State movement is correct?
o: The Constitution itself fixed 1 October 1953 as the date of Andhra State formation.
The Andhra State was formed before the Constitution came into force.
The Constitution of 26 January 1950 already included a separate Andhra State.
The Constitution of 26 January 1950 did not include a separate Andhra State.
accepted.x: There was no separate Andhra State in the Constitution as it came into force on 26 January 1950, although the Partition Committee had proposed that date in its deliberations.
accepted.tq: Watch for the false constitutional assumption created by a proposed date.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra State movement:
1. The Dhar Commission was set up before the Visalandhra Mahasabha.
2. Swami Sitaram's fast preceded the formation of Andhra State.
3. The second Visalandhra Mahasabha was held at Hyderabad in June 1954.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Dhar Commission preceded the 1949 Visalandhra Mahasabha, Swami Sitaram fasted in 1951, and the second Visalandhra Mahasabha met at Hyderabad on 13–14 June 1954.
accepted.tq: Combine chronology with place and date details to test more than one dimension of the sequence.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: Who presided over the second Visalandhra Mahasabha held at Hyderabad on 13–14 June 1954?
accepted.x: The second Visalandhra Mahasabha, held at Hyderabad on 13–14 June 1954, was presided over by Sri Sri.
accepted.tq: Use the event–place–president association to distinguish organisational leaders.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: Which of the following changes best describes the position of B. Ramakrishna Rao in 1954?
o: He shifted in favour of the merger of Telugu-speaking areas.
He opposed the formation of any Andhra State.
accepted.x: In 1954, B. Ramakrishna Rao shifted to favour the merger of Telugu-speaking areas.
accepted.tq: Test a leader's change of position rather than merely identifying his office.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: The States Reorganisation Commission appointed in December 1953 is associated with which of the following persons?
accepted.x: The States Reorganisation Commission appointed in December 1953 is identified with Fazal Ali.
accepted.tq: Apply the person–institution association while avoiding similarly placed Andhra leaders.
accepted.sec: Chronology of the Andhra State movement

accepted.s: The Sri Bagh Pact was signed on:
accepted.x: The Sri Bagh Pact was signed on 16 November 1937.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact day and year from nearby milestones in the Andhra movement.

accepted.s: The Sri Bagh Pact was concluded between leaders representing:
accepted.x: The pact brought together leaders of Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema to address regional concerns before pursuing a common Andhra demand.
accepted.tq: Identify the two negotiating regional groups rather than the later state units.

accepted.s: Which one of the following was NOT a provision of the Sri Bagh Pact?
o: A university centre at Anantapur along with the university at Waltair
Irrigation priority for Rayalaseema for ten years
Exclusive legislative control for Coastal Andhra over the Andhra region
Equal district-wise representation in the legislature
accepted.x: The pact did not provide exclusive legislative control to Coastal Andhra. It provided equal district-wise representation, university facilities at Waltair and Anantapur, and irrigation priority for Rayalaseema for ten years.
accepted.tq: Find the option that contradicts the pact's safeguards against regional domination.

accepted.s:
With reference to the Sri Bagh Pact, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra University was to remain at Waltair.
2. A university centre was to be established at Anantapur.
3. Rayalaseema was to receive irrigation priority for ten years.
4. Legislative seats were to be allotted district-wise on an equal basis.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements accurately describe the educational, irrigation and legislative safeguards included in the pact.
accepted.tq: Use the comprehensive option only after verifying every clause independently.

accepted.s: Under the Sri Bagh Pact, the capital and the High Court were to be:
o: Located at Waltair and Anantapur respectively
Located in separate regions, with Rayalaseema having the first choice
accepted.x: The pact provided that one of the capital and High Court would be in Rayalaseema and the other in the Circars, with Rayalaseema's choice being honoured first.
accepted.tq: Translate a negotiated regional safeguard into its practical institutional arrangement.

accepted.s: The irrigation provision of the Sri Bagh Pact related specifically to priority for Rayalaseema and Nellore in the waters of:
accepted.x: The pact granted Rayalaseema and Nellore priority for ten years in the utilisation of Krishna, Tungabhadra and Pennar waters.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure river pair and reject options containing an unrelated river.

accepted.s: The Sri Bagh Pact primarily sought to:
o: End the demand for a separate Andhra province
Establish Hyderabad as the permanent capital of Andhra
Allay Rayalaseema fears of Coastal Andhra domination
Create a separate university for Telangana
accepted.x: The pact was designed to remove Rayalaseema's fears of domination by Coastal Andhra and thereby facilitate a common Andhra demand.
accepted.tq: Identify the underlying political purpose rather than a specific clause.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with the Sri Bagh Pact?
o: Kadapa Koti Reddy — presided over the 1937 Silver Jubilee session
Kalluri Subbarao — drafted the Kurnool Circular
H.M. Sitaram Reddy — presided over the second Visalandhra Mahasabha
accepted.x: Kadapa Koti Reddy presided over the 1931 Special Andhra Sabha and the 1937 Silver Jubilee session. The Kurnool Circular was drafted by Kala Venkatarao, the second Visalandhra Mahasabha was presided over by Sri Sri, and H.M. Sitaram Reddy inaugurated the 1937 session.
accepted.tq: Use the person–role association and reject swapped office-holder traps.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the 1937 political context is correct?
o: The absence of Coastal Andhra ministers ended regional distrust.
Rajaji's cabinet consisted entirely of Rayalaseema ministers.
Rajaji's cabinet had no Rayalaseema minister, which deepened the regional rift.
The cabinet was formed only after Andhra State was created in 1953.
accepted.x: The absence of a Rayalaseema minister in Rajaji's cabinet in 1937 deepened the existing regional rift.
accepted.tq: Link a political circumstance with its stated regional consequence.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Pappuri Ramacharyulu stayed away from the anti-Andhra second Rayalaseema Mahasabha of 1935.
2. Koti Reddy stayed away from that meeting.
3. Gadicherla stayed away from that meeting.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Pappuri Ramacharyulu, Koti Reddy and Gadicherla all stayed away from the anti-Andhra second Rayalaseema Mahasabha held at Kadapa in 1935.
accepted.tq: Check each named participant separately before selecting the combined option.

accepted.s: Kalluri Subbarao is associated with which of the following events?
o: Presiding over the second Visalandhra Mahasabha
Leading the Salt Satyagraha in Bellary
Establishing the university centre at Anantapur
accepted.x: Kalluri Subbarao led the Salt Satyagraha in Bellary. The Kurnool Circular was drafted by Kala Venkatarao, while the other actions are not associated with him.
accepted.tq: Match a leader with his specific activity and avoid neighbouring Andhra movement roles.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the implementation of the Sri Bagh Pact in 1953?
o: The capital was established at Guntur and the High Court at Kurnool.
The capital was established at Kurnool and the High Court at Guntur.
The capital was established at Anantapur and the High Court at Madras.
Both the capital and High Court were established at Waltair.
accepted.x: When the pact was put into effect in 1953, Kurnool became the capital and Guntur became the location of the High Court.
accepted.tq: Compare the two institutions and avoid reversing their locations.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao — venue of the Sri Bagh Pact
Kalluri Subbarao — Salt Satyagraha in Bellary
N.G. Ranga — Rayalaseema signatory to the Sri Bagh Pact
H.M. Sitaram Reddy — inauguration of the 1937 session
accepted.x: N.G. Ranga was a Guntur leader and should not be treated as a Rayalaseema signatory. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Identify the regional-membership error in a list of otherwise plausible pairings.

accepted.s: The Sri Bagh Pact later served as a model for the:
accepted.x: The Sri Bagh Pact established a pattern of regional safeguards that was later used in the Gentlemen's Agreement of 1956.
accepted.tq: Connect an earlier regional arrangement with the later agreement that followed its pattern.
